title: N=100 Boundary Stress Panel

panel.blinding: WH policy reads frozen observed packets only. Predictions are serialized before scoring truth is loaded.

interpretation: This panel is designed to expose the current WH boundary, not maximize accuracy. Familiar cases test retained competence; boundary cases stress threshold robustness; ambiguous/underdetermined cases test epistemic restraint; novel cases test transfer beyond explicitly operationalized topology rules.
claim_ceiling: One prospectively frozen, shuffled N=100 synthetic boundary-stress panel characterizes failure modes and epistemic behavior of the current transparent WH policy under declared stressors. It does not establish real-world external validity, domain-general performance, causal proof, or human/MOAT-SCOPE superiority.
